key_point.kv_cache_pool_tokens_semantics: logged equivalent tokens; not usable capacity or simulator input
key_point.cache_rate_source: bmk prompt_tokens_by_source; denominator is all prompt tokens in that export

output_length_audit.mapping: source_trace_id + source_outer_idx + source_inner_idx; zero OSL becomes one

server_log.scope: all timestamps retained; profiling summary uses exported phase boundaries; Rust frontend counts are aggregate
server_log.timestamp_assumption: log timestamps interpreted as UTC, matching the saved export epoch and wall-clock boundaries

sampling.reference_recycle: shared sequential sampler, next draw when any tree completes
sampling.legacy_recycle: (lane + play_id * concurrency) modulo a seed-shuffled pool

router.rank_identity: worker URL @suffix; router index is position in the worker list

server.namespace_rule: explicit endpoint aliases plus all series labels; direct engine endpoint preferred
